details: Package name `@solana-labs/spl-toke` is one character short of the well-known `@solana/spl-token` library and is published under the `@solana-labs` scope rather than the canonical `@solana` scope. The shipped bundles `lib/index.cjs.js` and `lib/index.esm.js` contain `require('child_process')`, `https.get`, and `fetch(...) POST` constructs alongside `ping`-keyword matches in a minified form, but contextual tracing of those code paths did not complete and the keyword co-occurrence alone does not establish whether the bundle is a legitimate re-export of `@solana/spl-token` or an exfiltration payload. Given the suspicious name + scope confusion against a top-of-ecosystem Solana package, this requires human review to determine whether the bundle behavior is benign (mirrors upstream spl-token) or a typosquat dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
